baseline.wasteTruth: P's '~17.1s ffmpeg decode residual (detect_paddle.py:59-80)' was MISATTRIBUTED. Measured phase profile (74 frames): ffmpeg window decode + pipe wait 0.30s (input -ss/-to already decodes exactly the requested 74 frames — 460,339,200 bytes = 74x1920x1080x3, 0.74s standalone), PIL 0.10s, processor 0.43s, model forward 5.42s, post-process 0.25s, and 12.6s (170.7ms/frame) in the per-detection drain: box.tolist()/score.item()/label.item() on MPS result tensors = ~61 kept dets/frame x 3 synced GPU->CPU transfers each. Remaining per-invocation fixed overhead: python+torch+transformers import 5-7s, HF hub HEAD checks ~1s-4s, model load 1.5-1.8s.
